thread:
sam_supp: FYI — Acme Foods (proj: acme-prod) report: usage CSV export for 2025-01-10 to 2025-01-16 is missing two full days (2025-01-12, 2025-01-13). They say invoice shows tokens on those dates. Customer shared invoice INV-2025-0342 and export id exp_20250117_921.

lina_billing: Ack. Do we have the raw export response or job id? Need to confirm whether the export omitted files or rows.

sam_supp: They called our API: `GET /v1/usage/exports?project=acme-prod&start=2025-01-10&end=2025-01-16` — returned three objects: `2025-01-10.csv`, `2025-01-11.csv`, `2025-01-14-16.csv`. No 01-12 or 01-13 files. Customer attached the manifest.

oliver_runtime: Running quick check against aggregates. Querying aggregate store to see if tokens exist for those dates.

oliver_runtime: ```sql
SELECT date, SUM(token_count) AS tokens
FROM usage_aggregates
WHERE project_id = 'acme-prod'
  AND date BETWEEN '2025-01-10' AND '2025-01-16'
GROUP BY date
ORDER BY date;
```

oliver_runtime: Query result (quick snapshot):
2025-01-10 — 12,430
2025-01-11 — 9,120
2025-01-12 — 18,900  <-- present in aggregates
2025-01-13 — 15,600  <-- present in aggregates
2025-01-14 — 7,210
2025-01-15 — 6,000
2025-01-16 — 2,400

oliver_runtime: So aggregates show tokens for the missing dates. That points to an export job gap rather than missing ingestion.

maya_infra: I pulled the export job logs for `exp_20250117_921`. Looks like the export orchestration spawns per-shard workers. Shard mapping: date ranges are sharded by hash of project -> `shard-0..shard-7`. For acme-prod those dates landed on `shard-3`.

maya_infra: Ingest-bot shows a transient failure around `2025-01-13T03:12:08Z` when shard-3 attempted to finalize the day-level compaction: `Error: compaction timeout after 120s — worker pid 1421`. The export runner checks for finalized shard manifests; if a shard is not finalized the export skips it (to avoid partial rows).

ingest-bot: [system] shard-3 compaction failed, retry scheduled but max retries reached for window 2025-01-12..2025-01-13. Backfill not yet executed.

sam_supp: That matches customer's symptom — invoice (billing pipeline) reads from finalized aggregates (which succeeded) while CSV export reads finalized shard manifests (which failed for shard-3). So billing shows tokens but export skipped the shard.

lina_billing: Thanks. Customer will want an immediate export and clarity on reconciliation. Suggested next steps: 1) manual export of the missing shard range, 2) run backfill/compaction for shard-3 and re-run export pipeline, 3) offer a one-off credit if export delay caused them operational pain.

maya_infra: I can run the manual compaction+backfill for shard-3 now. Estimated runtime ~10–15 minutes for the two days. After compaction I'll trigger a manual export for `2025-01-12` and `2025-01-13` and upload those CSVs to the customer's export manifest.

oliver_runtime: I'll add a short-term fix to change export runner to attempt a one-time fetch of non-finalized shards (with a warning) for requests older than 24h so customers don't get silent skips. Longer-term we shouldn't silently omit dates.

lina_billing: I'll prepare a customer message template and pending credit authorization. Sam, can you tell Acme: ETA ~30m for manual export + we'll follow up with a permanent fix?

sam_supp: Yup. I'll update them now.

sam_supp: Message to customer (sent): "Thanks — we found the issue: an internal compaction failure caused two days to be skipped in the CSV export manifest even though billing records exist. We're running a manual backfill and will upload fresh CSVs for 2025-01-12 and 2025-01-13 within ~30 minutes. We'll also issue a one-time account credit; billing will follow up with details. Sorry for the inconvenience." :pray:

maya_infra: Backfill started at 2025-01-17T14:05:12Z. Logs: ```
[14:05:12Z] starting compaction shard-3 for 2025-01-12..2025-01-13
[14:05:22Z] compaction step 1 complete
[14:10:03Z] compaction step 2 complete
[14:12:01Z] finalizing manifest
```

maya_infra: Manual export completed and uploaded. Manifest now contains `2025-01-12.csv` and `2025-01-13.csv`. I also kicked an automated re-run for exports between 2025-01-10 and 2025-01-16 to regenerate the consolidated artifact.

lina_billing: I'll queue the credit: 100% of token charges for the two missing days as a gesture, pending manager approval.

sam_supp: Customer replied: "Thanks — received the two CSVs and the files match our records. Appreciate the quick turnaround." :thumbsup:

oliver_runtime: Filed a short postmortem issue: `PM-3456` to prevent silent skips and add monitoring alert for shard compaction failures affecting export manifests.

maya_infra: Action items: [maya_infra] run backfill (done), [oliver_runtime] patch export runner to surface non-finalized shards fallback, [lina_billing] issue credit, [sam_supp] confirm closed with customer.

sam_supp: Closing thread after I confirm the billing credit is applied. Thanks all. :+1:
